purpose: Independent verification of the two implementation corrections recorded in REPORT_1B.md 1.4, which moved structural resolution from 29.2% to 67.1% and changed the Stage 2 recommendation.
procedure: floor of 2 per mechanism, remainder by largest share of the remaining affected occurrences (ties by mechanism name); within a mechanism, occurrences sorted by (doc_id, start, type) then shuffled with random.Random(seed); final order by (mechanism, doc_id, start)

mechanisms.field_label_self: detection span IS the field label, not the value
mechanisms.provider_block: credential field inheriting the clinician its block is about
mechanisms.added_label: field label added to FIELD_LABEL_OWNER during the corrections
mechanisms.added_section: section header added to SECTION_OWNER during the corrections
